51983-the-sin-that-was-his.description: A book by Frank L. Packard. due possibly, or possibly not, to the rigours of the climate. Three-Ace Artie since then had grown a full beard. But Leroy's arrival, being but one of so many, the old-timers had found in it nothing to remember.

arxiv-1910-08777.title: Gem-induced trisections of compact PL 4 4 -manifolds
arxiv-1910-08777.creator: Maria Rita Casali, Paola Cristofori
arxiv-1910-08777.description: Abstract The idea of studying trisections of closed smooth 4 4 -manifolds via (singular) triangulations, endowed with a suitable vertex-labelling by three colors, is due to Bell, Hass, Rubinstein and Tillmann, and has been applied by Spreer and Tillmann to standard simply-connected 4 4 -manifolds, via the so called simple crystallizations .

arxiv-2105-02127.title: A class of new high-order finite-volume TENO schemes for hyperbolic conservation laws with unstructured meshes Journal: XXXX
arxiv-2105-02127.creator: Zhe Ji, Tian Liang, Lin Fu
arxiv-2105-02127.description: Abstract The recently proposed high-order TENO scheme [Fu et al., Journal of Computational Physics, 305(2016): 333-359] has shown great potential in predicting complex fluids owing to the novel weighting strategy, which ensures the high-order accuracy, the low numerical dissipation, and the sharp shock-capturing capability. However, the applications are still restricted to simple geometries with Cartesian or curvilinear meshes.

arxiv-2108-10697.title: Does Adversarial Oversampling Help us? CCS: Imbalance Classification adversarial approach CCS: Computing methodologies generative adversarial networks
arxiv-2108-10697.creator: Tanmoy Dam, Md Meftahul Ferdaus, Sreenatha G. Anavatti, Senthilnath Jayavelu, Hussein A. Abbass
arxiv-2108-10697.description: Abstract . Traditional oversampling methods are generally employed to handle class imbalance in datasets. This oversampling approach is independent of the classifier; thus, it does not offer an end-to-end solution. To overcome this, we propose a three-player adversarial game-based end-to-end method, where a domain-constraints mixture of generators, a discriminator, and a multi-class classifier are used.

arxiv-2307-04891.title: Accelerated Discovery of Machine-Learned Symmetries: Deriving the Exceptional Lie Groups G 2 G_{2} , F 4 F_{4} and E 6 E_{6} Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2307-04891.creator: Roy T. Forestano, Konstantin T. Matchev, Katia Matcheva, Alexander Roman, Eyup B. Unlu, Sarunas Verner
arxiv-2307-04891.description: Abstract Recent work has applied supervised deep learning to derive continuous symmetry transformations that preserve the data labels and to obtain the corresponding algebras of symmetry generators. This letter introduces two improved algorithms that significantly speed up the discovery of these symmetry transformations.

arxiv-2411-06693.title: The structure of interval orders with no infinite antichain Thanks: *The author is supported by the Canadian Defence Academy Research Program and NSERC
arxiv-2411-06693.creator: Maurice Pouzet, Imed Zaguia*
arxiv-2411-06693.description: Abstract . We prove that if G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) is a nonprime graph with either no infinite independent set or no infinite clique, then every vertex of G G belongs to a maximal strong module distinct from V V . In particular, G G admits a Gallai decomposition.

arxiv-2411-07456.title: Second Harmonic Hall Response in Insulators: Inter-band Quantum Geometry and Breakdown of Kleinman’s Conjecture
arxiv-2411-07456.creator: Wen-Yu He, K. T. Law
arxiv-2411-07456.description: Abstract The nonlinear Hall effect has recently garnered significant attention as a powerful probe of Fermi surface quantum geometry in metals. While current studies mainly focus on the nonlinear Hall response driven by quasi-static electric fields of low frequencies, the extension of the response to higher frequencies is another promising frontier, which introduces quantum geometry into inter-band transitions.

arxiv-2501-13604.title: FedPref: Federated Learning Across Heterogeneous Multi-objective Preferences
arxiv-2501-13604.creator: Maria Hartmann, Grégoire Danoy, Pascal Bouvry
arxiv-2501-13604.description: Abstract . The Federated Learning paradigm is a distributed machine learning strategy, developed for settings where training data is owned by distributed devices and cannot be shared with others. Federated Learning circumvents this constraint by carrying out model training in distribution, so that each participant, or client, trains a local model only on its own data.

arxiv-2508-11562.title: Supercritical phase of the random connection model
arxiv-2508-11562.creator: Mathew D. PenroseUniversity of Bath
arxiv-2508-11562.description: Abstract Given d ∈ ℕ , λ > 0 d\in\mathbb{N},\lambda>0 , the random connection model in a region A ⊆ ℝ d A\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{d} is a graph with vertex set given by a homogeneous Poisson point process of intensity λ \lambda in A A , with an edge placed between each pair x , y x,y of vertices with probability ϕ

arxiv-2511-23020.title: First Betti Number of real Calabi Yau Hypersurfaces: examples
arxiv-2511-23020.creator: Diego Matessi, Arthur Renaudineau
arxiv-2511-23020.description: Abstract . Continuing the investigation of real Calabi–Yau hypersurfaces in toric varieties obtained by patchworking, we present a new theorem concerning the computation of their first Betti number using mirror symmetry. Although the proof of this result will appear elsewhere, we focus here on its consequences and applications to the topology of real Calabi–Yau hypersurfaces. 1. Introduction 1.1.

govdocs-archive_org-nsia-CrawfordCliffor.description: March 14, 1971 letter from Harold Weisberg to Clifford Crawford of the Galloway School in Atlanta on providing a copy of his unpublished work, discussing the King assassination and the Fred Hampton-Mark Clark case.

pmc-11555910.title: Working towards consensus on the assessment of mood after severe acquired brain injury: Focus groups with UK-based professionals
pmc-11555910.creator: Alexandra E Rose, Breda Cullen, Sarah Crawford, Jonathan J Evans
pmc-11555910.description: ObjectiveThe assessment of mood after brain injury is more challenging when people have ongoing severe cognitive and receptive communication impairments. There is no gold standard on how these assessments should be undertaken. This study aimed to reach a consensus on this among specialists working with this population.DesignFocus groups were completed using a structured nominal group technique.

pmc-11618417.title: Comparison of Cell-Penetrating and Fusogenic TAT-HA2 Peptide Performance in Peptideplex, Multicomponent, and Conjugate siRNA Delivery Systems
pmc-11618417.creator: Metin Uz, Volga Bulmus, Sacide Alsoy Altinkaya
pmc-11618417.description: In this study, the performance of the cell-penetrating and fusogenic peptide, TAT-HA2, which consists of a cell-permeable HIV trans-activator of transcription (TAT) protein transduction domain and a pH-responsive influenza A virus hemagglutinin protein (HA2) domain, was comparatively evaluated for the first time in peptideplex, multicomponent, and conjugate siRNA delivery systems.

pmc-11678415.title: N-Acetyltyrosine as a Biomarker of Parenteral Nutrition Administration in First-Tier Newborn Screening Assays
pmc-11678415.creator: C. Austin Pickens, Samyukta Sah, Rahul Chandrappa, Samantha L. Isenberg, Elya R. Courtney, Timothy Lim, Donald H. Chace, Rachel Lee, Carla Cuthbert, Konstantinos Petritis
pmc-11678415.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Parenteral nutrition (PN) is a nutrient solution administered intravenously (IV) to premature babies. PN causes elevations of some amino acids in blood samples that are also biomarkers used in newborn screening (NBS). Therefore, PN status must be annotated by clinicians on dried blood spot (DBS) cards to reduce NBS laboratory burdens associated with potential false results; however, NBS laboratories continue to receive DBSs with misannotated PN status.

pmc-11726882.title: Neurocognitive Profile and Associated Factors Among Children Affected by Sickle Cell Disease in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11726882.creator: Patricia V M Lelo, Faustin Nd Kitetele, Marcel Kunyu, Cathy E Akele, Daniel L Okitundu, David Lackland Sam, Michael J Boivin, Espérance Kashala-Abotnes, Vicente Javier Clemente-Suárez, Alexandra Martín-Rodríguez
pmc-11726882.description: Background/Objectives: Understanding the neurocognitive profile of children with sickle cell disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is essential, as this condition can significantly affect their development. Our study aims to assess these children’s neurocognitive and developmental profiles and identify related factors.

pmc-12512596.title: Morphometric changes in overweight horses following 10-week weight loss programs
pmc-12512596.creator: Anna Garland, David A van Doorn, Robin van den Boom, Ellen Roelfsema, Lola Jung, Madeline Boast, Katerina Papadakis, Mary Margiotta, Samara Wafelbakker, Morgan Briggs, Persephone McCrae, Wendy Pearson
pmc-12512596.description: BackgroundUp to 70% of horses in domestic equine populations are overweight. Promotion of weight loss is an important component of limiting the detrimental co-morbidities associated with excess adipose tissue. The use of a body condition score (BCS) can help equine caregivers track their horse’s weight-status. However, this single score doesn’t reflect changes in individual adipose depots.

pmc-12911243.title: Comparative efficacy of myofascial release versus stretching combined with high-powered pulsed therapeutic ultrasound in amateur overhead athletes with active trapezius trigger point pain: a randomized clinical trial
pmc-12911243.creator: Nizamuddin Khan, Tushita Ghai, Richa Kashyap, Priyadarshani Bhat, Fuzail Ahmad, Amir Iqbal, Talal Alghadir, Faisal Alghadir, Shahnawaz Anwer, Ahmad H Alghadir
pmc-12911243.description: BackgroundActive myofascial trigger points (MTrPs) in the upper trapezius are a leading source of neck pain and functional limitation in athletes. Although myofascial release (MFR) and stretching are frequently used, their comparative effectiveness when combined with high-power pulsed therapeutic ultrasound (HPPT-US) remains unclear.

pmc-13317769.title: Comparing Post-Occlusion Surge at Decreasing Intraocular Pressures with Pressure Sensing Handpiece
pmc-13317769.creator: Jessie A Montgomery, Coby Soule, Nathan Sherbotie, Ivan A Cardenas, Jenna L Jensen, Jacob A Bell, William R Barlow Jnr, Kolja Klug, Lincoln Wagner, Jeff H Pettey

pmc-13320824.title: Benchmarking fMRI Denoising Pipelines
pmc-13320824.creator: Tianye Zhai, Hong Gu, Anika Holton, Elanor Chang, Blaise B Frederick, Thomas J Ross, Yihong Yang, Amy C Janes
pmc-13320824.description: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is a powerful tool for probing neuronal activity in vivo, but fMRI data are inherently noisy. To mitigate this, a wide range of denoising strategies have been developed, including volume censoring, anatomical component‐based noise correction (aCompCor), ICA‐based methods (e.g., AROMA, FIX), and multi‐echo approaches (e.g., ME‐ICA, tedana).

pmc-13425880.title: Artesunate-loaded bovine serum albumin nanoplatform with metal–polyphenol network coating for ferroptosis-driven breast cancer therapy
pmc-13425880.creator: Yinghong Huang, Yuanyuan Zhao, Yuhong Su, Chudong He, Mengdie Mo, Weijie Zhou, Yang Lu, Fei Yu
pmc-13425880.description: Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent programmed cell death process driven by reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation, represents a promising therapeutic strategy for breast cancer. However, the efficacy of ferroptosis therapy in breast cancer is often compromised by insufficient intracellular levels of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and iron ions.

uslaw-usc-t16-s831x.title: 16 U.S.C. § 831x — Condemnation proceedings; institution by Corporation; venue
uslaw-usc-t16-s831x.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s831x.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 12A (Tennessee Valley Authority). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Corporation may cause proceedings to be instituted for the acquisition by condemnation of any lands, easements, or rights-of-way which, in the opinion of the Corporation, are necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter. The proceedings shall be instituted in the United States district.
